product.title: Portland Afternoon City Tour

description.text: See Portland on an afternoon city sightseeing tour with stops at Pioneer Courthouse Square, the Pearl District, Nob Hill, and the International Rose Test Garden. A local guide shares Portland history and culture during a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter route with downtown hotel pickup.

highlights: Afternoon coach tour of Portland parks and neighborhoods
Visit the International Rose Test Garden in Washington Park
Explore the Pearl District and NW 23rd Avenue corridors
Hotel pickup and drop-off in downtown Portland
Small-group format with a maximum of 11 travelers

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

faqs.question: How long is the Portland Afternoon City Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 3 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Portland?
faqs.answer: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point listed in your booking confirmation.
